reviews.title: Works and looks great!
reviews.comment: This RAM was only $100 back in August 2025.  It works perfectly as advertised.  Remember that you need to go into Bios after installing to set the OC. RGB works well with AsRock motherboard.  This may not be Corsair brand but works and looks just as good.
reviews.author: Steve S.

reviews.title: Great Test Drive
reviews.comment:
Fast no stuttering, only time will tell.
Applications open quickly, no issues with high end games.
They look great, has smokey tent to them, no too overly bright.
Good price for 4 DDR5 sticks for 64 gb of memory capacity.
No compatibility issues from a new competitor in the RAM market motherboard picked them right up. First time seeing Acer brand for this product.
This is my 3rd build these will be added to my go to.
